# cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_basic_auth_credential (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_basic_auth_credential" "example_zero_trust_cws_basic_auth_credential" {
  account_id = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  credential_id = "182bd5e5-6e1a-4fe4-a799-aa6d9a6ab26e"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Cloudflare account ID (32-character hexadecimal string)

### Optional

- `credential_id` (String) ID of the credential to retrieve
- `filter` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) ID of the credential to retrieve
- `updated_at` (String)
- `username` (String) Login presented by the client. Printable ASCII only, excluding space and colon (RFC 7617 forbids a colon in the user-id).

<a id="nestedatt--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Optional:

- `deployment_id` (String) Filter to credentials attached to this deployment
- `direction` (String) Sort direction (default: asc)
Available values: "asc", "desc".
- `order` (String) Field to order results by (default: created_at)
Available values: "username", "created_at", "updated_at".
- `username` (String) Filter by username (case-insensitive substring match)
